description: This file contains a Smarty plugin implementing the {html_radios} function, which generates HTML radio button inputs based on provided parameters. It includes the main function smarty_function_html_radios and a helper smarty_function_html_radios_output to produce individual radio button HTML snippets.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_radios
methods.description: Generates a list of HTML radio input elements based on parameters like values, options, checked state, separator, and more.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_radios_output
methods.description: Constructs individual HTML radio input and label, handling escaping and state. Used internally by smarty_function_html_radios.
